headline: ANTAD sales have their weakest October in 13 years
summary: Sales at ANTAD-affiliated retail chains rose 1.6% in nominal terms in October 2026 from a year earlier, in stores open more than a year. ANTAD called it the weakest October in 13 years.
why: ANTAD represents Mexico's major supermarket and department store chains, so its sales data is a key read on domestic consumer demand.
original_headline: Ventas de ANTAD viven su octubre más débil en 13 años
